command: cd validation && uv run python a/gen_em.py
method: Infinitely thin centre-fed half-wave dipole, sinusoidal current (induced-EMF method). Balanis eq. 4-79 with kl = pi: cos(kl) = -1, sin(kl) = 0, so X_m = (eta0/4pi) Si(2 pi) (the radius term multiplies sin(kl) and vanishes) and R_r = (eta0/4pi) Cin(2 pi); Z_in = Z_m / sin^2(kl/2) = Z_m. Cin(x) = gamma + ln x - Ci(x).

flag_resolution.dipole: Z_in = 73.079010 + j42.515115 Ohm with eta0 = 376.730313412 Ohm (CODATA mu0); with the eta0 ~ 120 pi = 30 * 4 pi convention: 73.129602 + j42.544547 Ohm. Textbook 73 + j42.5 is the rounded form. Independent of wire radius only in the thin limit; FEM gates on the trend.
